claims.quote: Our construction services team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your construction services team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To ensure we are aligned and can provide the most relevant support, could you please clarify what you're looking for? This will help us prepare for a discovery meeting that addresses your specific needs.

We're here to help and look forward to your response.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
Cedar Systems
questions: What specific needs or goals does your construction services team have in mind?
Are there any particular challenges or objectives you're hoping to address with Cedar Systems?
uncertainties: The lack of a clear project owner or specific requirements makes it difficult to tailor the next steps effectively.
